My published spec (v1) already contains both `requires \valid_read(item);` and `ensures \result == 0 || \result == 1;`. No changes needed.

Published postcondition `ensures \result == (((tiles * tiles) * 2u) * 6u) * 3u;` under `requires tiles <= 10922u;`. The formula is mathematically exact (no uint32_t overflow) for tiles in [0, 10922]. Note: sshape_box_sizes allows tiles up to 26753 — above 10922, the C computation overflows uint32_t and the ACSL mathematical expression diverges, so the precondition cannot be weaker without misrepresenting the semantics. If sshape_box_sizes needs to cover the full range, it should narrow its own precondition to tiles <= 10922u or handle the overflow case separately.
